commands.link.github.description: Link your GitHub account by link or one-time code
commands.link.github.param_method: How to authorise; auto picks the smoothest one that is configured
commands.link.param_member: Whose binding to show (defaults to you)
commands.link.show.description: Show the GitHub account someone linked
github.link.conflict: The GitHub account **{login}** is already linked to {holder}. One GitHub account can only belong to one Discord user — ask them to unlink first, or use another GitHub account.
github.link.done: Linked the GitHub account **{login}**. Use the `/github` panel to undo it.
github.link.expired: Timed out and this attempt is void (the device code expired). Open the `/github` panel and try again.
github.link.failed: Linking failed: GitHub returned `{error}`. Open the `/github` panel and try again.
github.link.start_failed: Could not start the GitHub authorisation ({error}). Try again later; if it keeps failing, check the network and the OAuth App configuration.
github.link.title: Link your GitHub account
github.not_configured: The GitHub integration is not configured: set `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` in `.env` (the client_id of an OAuth App with "Enable Device Flow" ticked) and restart the bot.
github.show.empty: No GitHub account linked. Use the `/github` panel to link one.
github.show.title: GitHub binding of {member}
github.web.bad_state_body: This link was already used or has expired. Open the `/github` panel in Discord and try again.
github.web.conflict_body: That GitHub account is already linked to another Discord user. One GitHub account can only belong to one Discord user — ask them to unlink first, or use another account.
github.web.denied_body: You cancelled the authorisation on GitHub. Open the `/github` panel in Discord to retry.
github.web.endpoint_off: The web flow needs the bot's inbound endpoint, but `WEB_PORT` is not configured (so it is not listening). Either set `WEB_PORT` and expose it through a tunnel/reverse proxy, or leave the web flow unconfigured so the panel uses the device flow.
github.web.exchange_failed_body: GitHub refused to exchange this authorisation. Open the `/github` panel in Discord to retry.
github.web.not_configured: The web flow is not configured yet: it needs `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` and `GITHUB_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI` (the latter must be set as the OAuth App's callback URL). Without them the device flow is used automatically.
github.web.success_body: Linked the GitHub account {login}. You can close this page and go back to Discord.
commands.github.param_group: List bindings of members with this role
commands.github.param_check: Reverse lookup by GitHub login or numeric ID
github.one_param: get_member / get_group / check: give only one.
github.panel.title: GitHub account
github.panel.unlinked: No GitHub account linked yet. Your GitHub identity is your login.
github.all.title: All bindings
github.member.title: GitHub binding of {member}
github.group.title: Bindings for role {role}
github.group.none: Nobody with this role has linked GitHub yet.
github.check.title: GitHub lookup
github.check.not_found: No binding found for that GitHub account.
modules.github_bridge.description: Link Discord users to GitHub accounts (device flow; stores identities, never tokens).
modules.github_bridge.name: GitHub accounts
